_comment: Frozen before any retrieval code (Phase 5). Changes after a held-out run are not allowed; changes after development runs must be committed before the held-out run.

structured.entities: names in the question that match a referent label in scope (LoCoMo speakers; rule-extracted referents)
structured.candidates: turns authored by or naming those entities, inside the question's time window when gupi.timeexpr reads one from the question relative to its date
structured.ranking: turns that are evidence for an extracted claim about the entity first, then newest first

hybrid.filter: restrict to the structured candidates when there are any, otherwise unrestricted

scope.longmemeval: the question's own history sessions, as of its question_date

metrics: recall@k (share of gold evidence units in the top k)
hit@k (any gold unit in the top k)
